subject: price-sentiment chart keeps the previous series when new data is empty
activeForm: Clearing the chart series on an empty response

work_items: price-sentiment chart keeps the previous series when new data is empty

description:
Status: CARDED, not started. Found during signed-sentiment-fanout research (pending
refuter confirmation there; verify before building).

## Symptom

Switching the chart's source mode appears to work: a line renders in every mode. In
fact the non-aggregated modes return empty history (see
specs/001-source-attribution-dead/card.md) and the chart silently keeps drawing the
previous mode's line.

## Mechanism

`frontend/src/components/charts/price-sentiment-chart.tsx:485`:
`if (!sentimentSeriesRef.current || !sentimentData.length) return;` — the effect
early-returns on empty data and never calls `setData([])`, so the last non-empty
series stays on screen. The user sees stale data presented as the selected mode.

## Fix sketch

Clear the series (`setData([])`) or render an explicit empty state when the response
is empty. Decide with the source-attribution card: once real sources flow, empty
modes become rare but still possible (e.g. a ticker with only one provider's
coverage), and silence is still a lie then.
